[attribute-absent]
=== `@absent` absent

Used to state that the required element <<element-tbx-term,`<tbx:term>`>> has been left empty deliberately and is therefore not an error.

#### OPTIONAL on element:  <<element-tbx-term,`<tbx:term>`>>

|===
| Value| Meaning

| yes| The element <<element-tbx-term,`<tbx:term>`>> has no content, it has been left empty deliberately
| no| The element <<element-tbx-term,`<tbx:term>`>> has content as usual. This value need never be used, the content of <<element-tbx-term,`<tbx:term>`>> is sufficient.
| Restriction| This attribute is an optional attribute; there is no default.
|===
